text:
HyperNova Labs is a seed-stage startup building an AI co-pilot for product teams — think fast, reliable generative assistants that turn specs and data into working features. We move quickly, iterate on models and infra, and ship production-grade ML systems that users love.

What you'll do
- Own end-to-end development of generative AI features: design, prototype, productionize.
- Build and optimize Large Language Model-based services and inference pipelines for latency, cost and safety.
- Integrate models with downstream systems using step functions and orchestrations to create robust, stateful flows.
- Implement monitoring, testing and rollout strategies for model behavior in production.
- Collaborate with product, infra and ML ops to define SLAs, data requirements, and feedback loops to continuously improve models.

What we need (mandatory)
- Python
- Large Language Models or Step Functions
- 6-10 years

Bonus points (good-to-have)
- Prompt Engineering
- Vector Databases
- Generative AI
- LangChain

Location and work mode
Fully remote within India.
